name: Hi-Light 航轮 R6 105 AL
why_interesting: An unusually low official-price titanium complete-bike lead whose exact China drivetrain and complete weight remain unpublished.

facts.frame: Hi-Light R6 3Al–2.5V titanium frame with carbon fork
facts.frame_construction: Conventional non-hydroformed titanium tubes; internal cable routing with the housing exposed below the bottom bracket on the current regional specification
facts.stiffness_evidence: The official regional distributor differentiates R6 by its simpler conventional-tube construction. No independent exact-model stiffness or deflection measurement was found across the 50-area sweep; this is qualitative construction context, not a measured result.
facts.frame_weight_basis: Official Japanese distributor approximate frame weight for size L; package contents and measurement method are not stated
facts.tire_clearance_basis: Manufacturer maximum: ETRTO 35-622 / 700×35C on the exact R6 frame
facts.sizes: S, M, L, XL and XXL; custom sizing offered

missing: Exact China R6 105 AL drivetrain and complete component package
Complete-bike weight with size, pedals and measurement method
Independent exact-model stiffness or deflection measurement
Current mainland checkout observation, domestic warranty issuer and invoice handling

official_price.price_basis: Manufacturer-listed retail price for the exact R6 105 AL complete-bike record; no current mainland checkout was observed

source_note: The exact official China page lists CNY 8,300. Exact frame and current regional distributor pages establish R6 construction, interfaces, frame weight basis and clearance; they do not establish the China complete-build drivetrain or complete weight.
